# MH-26 — Notify late hiker

**Business value:** 895

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an hiker
I want to be alerted when the expected arrival time is passed
So that I can manage the registration

## Notes

When the time of arrival has passed by more than 30 minutes and the hiker has not yet confirmed safe arrival a notification is sent both via email and as a popup on the app
